paragraphs: Ridango is a mobility technology group built around automated fare collection, payments and real-time information systems for public transport. It sells to transport authorities and operators, working with them on the efficiency, accessibility and sustainability of their transit services.

The account-based ticketing platform is modular, pulling customer management, fare models, products, media, sales channels, device control and reporting into one configurable environment. Authorities and operators are meant to define their own products and fare matrixes and push updates without waiting on the vendor. Ridango also makes the hardware, including a self-service validator that reads contactless bank cards, EMV smart cards and QR mobile tickets. A compact handheld device covers both ticket inspection and on-board ticket sales.

The group is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden and was established in 2009 in Tallinn, Estonia. It reports that more than 150 public transport authorities and operators use its systems, across more than 25 countries. Among the customers named on the solutions page is a mobility authority in Vilnius. Under recognitions and memberships the site describes the International Association of Public Transport, a non-profit advocacy organization for public transport authorities and operators.

quote.text: Ridango is a global mobility technology group, with a focus on automated fare collection, payments and real-time information systems.
